hooks: RemoveMacAI turns off Apple Intelligence and deletes its models.
Apple Intelligence removal frees up to 12 GB of space, says the tool’s author.
what_happened: The open‑source RemoveMacAI app disables Apple Intelligence, deletes its models and stops related analytics, ads and background updaters.
try_it: On macOS, run `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omlahore/RemoveMacAI/main/install.sh | bash -s app` or download the zip and open the app.
why_it_matters: It gives users back roughly 12 GB of disk space and stops unwanted AI data collection.
the_catch: It only works on macOS 27 and requires the user to run the app or command‑line tool; it cannot be used on earlier macOS versions.
caption: RemoveMacAI disables Apple Intelligence on macOS, freeing about 12 GB of storage. Want the extra space or just privacy?

es.hook: RemoveMacAI desactiva Apple Intelligence y elimina sus modelos.

es.try_it: En macOS, ejecuta `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/omlahore/RemoveMacAI/main/install.sh | bash -s app` o descarga el zip y abre la aplicación.
es.why_it_matters: Recuperas aproximadamente 12 GB de espacio en disco y evitas la recopilación no deseada de datos de IA.
es.the_catch: Solo funciona en macOS 27 y requiere que el usuario ejecute la aplicación o la herramienta de línea de comandos; no se puede usar en versiones anteriores de macOS.
